newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan Int'l Airline seeks fare rise.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan Int'l Airline seeks fare rise.

text.p: State-run Pakistan International Airline (PIA) has urged the government to allow it to raise passenger and cargo fares by 20 percent, a PIA executive said on Thursday.
"The raise is needed after a sharp rise in fuel costs," said the executive, who asked not to be named, adding that government approval was needed before PIA could increase its fares.

He said PIA would raise the pricing issue at an emergency meeting of the International Air Transport Association (IATA) due to be held in Geneva on November 13 to consider concerted action over rising fuel costs.
IATA has said the average fuel price paid by its members in the first nine months of calendar 1996 was 73.9 cents/gallon compared to 65.2 cents in the same period of 1995.
